'''DarthVader,AOE Imperial Occupation - PLAYERS PRECONSTRUCT 6''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[DarthVader,AOE]]
* '''Published:''' 21 February 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Scenario
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control|SE-D-imperialoccupation.gif|label=Imperial Occupation}}
* '''Strategy:''' Imperial Occupation
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 IOcc DarthVader,AOE DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Use the might of the evil galactic Empire to crush that Rebel scum and force them into a devastating retreat! Target the Main Generators at MAXIMUM FIREPOWER!

The published list has 66 cards.

== Strategy ==

This deck has alot of great "pull" cards. Dragon Bones pulls Wampas, Praji pulls pilots, ect. If there's something you need to put the smack down on the Rebs, just pluck it from the trees! This is (in my opinion) the best of Player's Preconstructs that has been built so far! Good job!
